title: Term Life Insurance Beneficiary and Settlement Limits
content:
Term Life Insurance applies one set of beneficiary and settlement limits to all six tiers.

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| Primary beneficiaries in one designation, at most | 10 |
| Smallest share designated to one beneficiary (whole percents only) | 1% |
| Age below which a beneficiary's share is paid only to a court-appointed guardian or UTMA custodian | 18 |
| Smallest payee share that may be settled into an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account (USD) | 10000 |

Hypothetical: a payee share of 10000.00 may be settled into an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account; a share of 9999.99 may not. A beneficiary aged 17 at payment is below the age of 18.
